title: WRP: Weight Recover Prune for Structured Sparsity

layout.note: Top row left to right: dense matrix, prune arrow, 2:4 pattern, Compress as 2:4 arrow, then a green Values grid and an orange 2-bit indices grid at the right. One vertical arrow drops from the 2:4 pattern to a second row: the recover weight grid, a Compress as CSR arrow and three stacked CSR strips at the right. Matrix names sit under the grids and operation names above the arrows.

lesson: Explain a data-format or pruning method on one small matrix with numbered cells, redrawn at the same size after each operation, with one colour per kind of stored content, so a reader can trace any entry by its number.
